card.name: Small words in news event reports
card.fires_on: Small linking words (when, a, over, at, to, in, by, last) right after a verb or noun describing an event, such as a strike, outbreak, landing or discovery, in news-style reports. The next words usually give where, when or who.

modes.label: Event of impact or spread
modes.description: Linking word after an asteroid, disease or outbreak event, leading into where or to whom it happened.
modes.example: A similar phenomenon occurred in July 2009<< when>> a suspected asteroid slammed into Jupiter.

modes.label: Discovery or finding reports
modes.description: Linking word after found or discovered, leading into the place, time or finder.
modes.example: Her unclothed body was found<< by>> police after the fact.

modes.label: Place of an outbreak or landing
modes.description: Preposition after a spread or landing verb, leading into the location.
modes.example: Cuban exiles, landed<< at>> the Bay of Pigs on the southern

card.writes: It leans toward words like discovered, suspected and investigated, which suggests narrative accounts of reported events.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in news accounts of events like outbreaks, crashes or discoveries, just before the details of where or who.
